feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 November 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 21 November 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex area of low pressure and associated frontal zones to the west of Ireland as a ridge of high pressure to the east of Iceland extends south to affect the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, steadily increasing 6 or 7 later this evening and overnight, decreasing mainly 5 or 6 later tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate this evening and then moderate or rough overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 through the evening, veering south or southeast overnight into Monday, then increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the west at first.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
